description: Color decisions rely on category stereotypes rather than source/role logic
Typography is selected from category fashion without morphology/role rationale
Hero matches common eyebrow + huge centered heading + paragraph + two CTA + glow composition
Most information is enclosed in rounded bordered cards without containment/action reason
Most sections are separated by identical thin borders
Same entrance recipe repeats across most sections
UI, media, type and 3D share identical timing/easing
Identity disappears when glow/gradient blobs are removed
Bento grid exists without information hierarchy that benefits from it
Decorative pills/eyebrows repeat without semantic information
Translucent blurred panels used as generic premium signal
Every section uses identical max-width/header/grid rhythm despite content differences
Motion-heavy page never gives reading/static ranges
